references.text: Moses reminds the Israelites that they were disobedient to the Lord's command and went up to the mountain against his will.
Moses describes how the people were disobedient and did not trust the Lord when he sent them from Kadesh-Barnea.
The Lord had commanded the people to turn back toward the wilderness, but they chose to go against his command.
Samuel warns that disobedience to the Lord's word is like the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is like idolatry.
Zedekiah did not humble himself before the prophet Jeremiah, who spoke on behalf of the Lord, an example of violating the Lord's command.
Proverbs teaches that no wisdom, understanding, or counsel can prevail against the Lord.
Isaiah warns against rebellious children who carry out plans that do not come from the Lord.
Jeremiah accuses the people that those who were to lead them in the ways of the Lord did not know him and broke the covenant.
Jeremiah warns that fighting against the Lord will not succeed.
